_comment: Hand-labeled MRZ ground truth for 5 real photos from assets/pic (read from 3x-upscaled crops on 2026-09-26). Composite digits verified with the TRUE ICAO formula cd(L2[0:10]+L2[13:20]+L2[21:43]) — all pass. NOTE: the repo's own composite implementation (cd(L2[0:43])) FAILS on all 5, which is itself a confirmed bug (P0). Use this file for the real-photo eval gate: char-acc per line, line-exact, and true-ICAO validity of OCR output.
